chapters: Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu chio'ñ na tu juan bhaan gu Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu Moisees jix koi; gio ba' bamii' jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Jordaan tu' bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' dhagia' na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaas tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' dɨr oidha' jix gaki dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates bɨx gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' gu tas ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' soo'mchulhdhak tu' gu kutun gu vupui jix bhai'x bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'; gio ba' na ja'p tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Moisees jix duñia' bɨndak; mi' dhɨr cham tu' mi'x dhaas tu' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' tu' jix kavɨk; na gu' tu' gu takarui' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ux gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu takarui' tattat gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk na ba' gu takarui' duñia' jurtu'nka' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga tu duukam gu Moisees tu' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook tu' kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨx tu'x gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' u'uan gu chuukug ñi'ook na tu a'ga cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chin; gio ba' va'k gu tanoolh gu tukaa' gu jodai' na ba' nukadham gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak; na gu' jano' ba' jix duu gu tasi' gu bhóogɨt bɨx tu' gu jodai' xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk; na gu' cham jum i'obh tu' gu suudai' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak pai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi' jix aa'ñdhix gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu Prebeniios jugi; na gu' gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan na ba' kapbhai' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Josuee gu jodai' gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu vaakax jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Moisees tu' jix maa dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gu' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam u'ua'tɨdham.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ gio gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' gu oi'ñga'n gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan bhaan pai' gu bhóogɨt gu tas; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee bham; gio ba' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu takarui' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx tu'x tu' gu suudai' tu'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak na ja'p ka't bɨɨx gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' no'x ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun bhañ dɨr gu Sittim gook gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu oidha' gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu baap gu vaak gu u'vɨ ganai' jup tɨɨt gu Raab gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo bham; gio ba' gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨbiap dhi' gu tukaa' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo bhañ a'ga gu Raab; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' tɨbiap tu' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu vaak; na gu' jix duñia' tɨbiap gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu oidha'.
Gu' gu' gu u'vɨ ka't jix bhɨɨ gook gu chichio'ñ ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'r gu chichio'ñ tɨɨtɨs tu' gu' cham gu takarui' duukat jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu ki'ñgob gu suudai' tu' jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ moor cham tu' duukat jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu tasi' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu tasi' ga'ra' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'; gio ba' ki'ñgob ka't jix kup mi' dhɨr moor bhaan jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' va'k gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' choo'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu vaak bhaan no'ch bɨx jix koi gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux kuiñcha gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu jodai' naak gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk moor gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Seoon gu Og jix duñia' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' tu' gu bhóogɨt chulhiiñdha' gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ oi'ñdha' gu ux kuiñcha gu takarui'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jiix gu tɨkɨr gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaak gu taat jix duñia' nɨi'ñchudat dhuu.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam sɨspidhi'ñ bɨx gu kutun; gio ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu tasi' koi'm.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm koi'm tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu chuukug; na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa gu oidha' no'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' jix dhaav bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu vaak ka't gu maa'nkar gu tasi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi'.

Ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk na gu' jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' no'ch duduaka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu takarui'.

Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk no'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu' gu chuukug dhi' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook mai' kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o no'ch cham gu ñi'ook; gu' no'x gu vaak bɨndak gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan gu kutun mo'o tu' gu novɨ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu chuukug no'ch duduaka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu kavɨk jix duñia' vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm oi'ñchu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bhiadat gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu chichio'ñ jix dhaav gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' bɨx gu oidha' gu novɨ gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gio bɨx jix koi gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Josuee gu xibh gu ñi'ook gu Sittim tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' va'k gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bham; na pai' dhuuk gu jodai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ux na tu ibai' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook pai' gu ñi'ook.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug ka't jix bhai'x na ja'p gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai' jix duñia' tu'; na gu' gu chuukug cham jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ va'k jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu xibh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' kɨɨ'p.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh kua'da' gu chuukug jix gɨ' vupui bhaan gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel na ba' kɇɇkɇ' na ja'p jix duñia' bɨɨx gu Moisees jix duñia' bɨndak.

Jano' ba' tu' jix aa'ñdhix jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bham; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n kia'mi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm jannulhi'ñ gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josuee; gio ba' dhi' jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu Kananeo gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan aapi' bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jano' gu kutun gu chichio'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bopxi'ñ maa'n.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu vaas tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios aapi' bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu suudai' jupaabkamu'n jiix gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam vaak zel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' baap gu Jordaan na ja'p tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' jugii'ñ gu suudai' na gu' gu Jordaan gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook oraa'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' aajidha' jiix gu ñi'ook na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk xoi'kam jix duñia' kiicham gu Adam gu ñi'ook gu Saretan; gio ba' jix dhaav gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo.

Gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix gaki jiimda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix gaki.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam gu kutun gu chichio'ñ bopxi'ñ maa'n.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan pai' jiimda' tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu kutun gu jodai gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu kutun pai' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu kutun gu chichio'ñ ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bopxi'ñ maa'n.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr maa'n gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ gu jodai bhaan gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' na ba' dhi' ka't nɨi'ñchudat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam tu ñi'ook tattat gu xibh bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dhi' gu jodai.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na gu suudai' gu Jordaan jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu suudai' gu Jordaan jix duñia'; jano' ba' dhi' gu jodai ka't gu ux chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duu na ja'p gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix; na jix búup gu kutun gu jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Josuee jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook baidhak gu kutun jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee gio jix búup gu kutun gu jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan pai' jix duñia' tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' dhi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Moisees ka't gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix maa gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gio kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu Moisees ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p oo'm jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bhaan vaak ja'tkam gu Jerikoo vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Josuee gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees bɨx gu tanoolh gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan gu vaas tɨɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' jix gaki gu suudai' gu Jordaan suulh pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ja'p va'k bhaan bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jordaan mambhɨɨx gu takarui' maa'n jix duñia' yooxi' gu Gilgal gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix duñia' gu Gilgal gu kutun gu jodai gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk gu xibh tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam tattat gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu suudai' dhi' gu jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam bham; gio ba' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix gaki gu ux dhi' gu Jordaan.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai'.
Na ba' na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu suudai' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk; na ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Kananeos mi'p mia'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu chuukug na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm a'lhiok gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gookim jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' kuiñcha gu ux gu Josuee jix duñia'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto gu chichio'ñ bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu suudai' jix koi oidha' jix gaki gu ux gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook mi'p gu oi'ñga'n; gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't maaxir oidha' jix gaki gu ux gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto cham mi'p gu oi'ñga'n.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu ux oidha' jix gaki oo'm gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto ka't gu suudai' na gu' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook tattat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook pai' gu takarui' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug pai' gu Josuee jix duñia'; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' pai' yooxi' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Ejipto; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' ka't tɨɨgim gu Gilgal bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' yooxi' gu Gilgal jix duñia' gakdhi'ñchix gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu takarui' gu ux gu xumai gu bhóogɨt gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gakdhi'ñchix koi'mɨk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu takarui' cham jabka' gu tanoolh kaipgaidhat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix utu'ñ gu tanoolh buimgidhak dɨr kua'da' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n chooto'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook koi'mɨk gu i'bhɨ gu oidha' gu Kanaan mii' dhɨr oi'ñga'.

Jano' ba' kua' gu Josuee mia'n gu Jerikoo jix duñia' gu vupui jix ñi' gu chio'ñ ka't vupui bhaan ga'ra' gu kuchii cham kutun gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Josuee gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham; gu' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios jano' tɨbiap; jano' ba' gu Josuee gu takarui' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' jix duñia'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tɨɨt; na gu' pai' gu jodai' jix bhaan; jano' ba' gu Josuee jix duu.
Gu' gu' gu Jerikoo ka't jix kup xoi'kam jix kup kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak jix duñia' tu' busaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jiimchu' xikoolh kiicham jix duñia'; gio ba' dhi' jix duu gu ux gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kɨɨv gu suudai' a'aa' gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix duñia' kɨɨv gu ñi'ook kiicham jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu suudai'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu chuukug bɨtaa'n; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ maa'n gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' tɨɨt gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' a'aa' gu chuukug vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix duñia' kiicham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee ka't tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' kɨɨv gu suudai' a'aa' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'ñdhix gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' bhaan cham jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu oi'ñga'n xikoolh kiicham tɨɨtɨs vaak ja'tkam chooto'n gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix búup gu xibh jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' kɨɨv gu suudai' a'aa' gu chuukug jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jiim bɨɨx tas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu suudai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gook gu tanoolh suulh vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' dhi' jix duu gu ux gu tanoolh.
Na pai' dhuuk kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix búup na pai' dhuuk jix tɨ'ɨ gu maa'nkar jix maa gu oi'ñga'n kiicham kɨɨv mui'kim; gio ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu tanoolh jix maa gu oi'ñga'n xikoolh kɨɨv mui'kim.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan a'lhiok dhaa gu suudai' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu Josuee gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix maa gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' kiicham.
Gu' gu' kiicham ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx tu'x; na gu' gu suudai' gu Raab ganai' ii'mdagaram bɨɨx bɨx gu vaak bɨɨx na gu' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug tu' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook na gu' cham xoi'kam gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' bɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu ux gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai ka't jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n chumñigam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix maa gu bhóogɨt jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't na ja'p gu ja'tkam ka't naak gu suudai' gu chuukug jix maa gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ kiicham maa'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug bɨx kiicham ka't; gio ba' gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kɨklhi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm gu vaakax kakneer gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Josuee gook gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' gu takarui' gu oidha'; gio ba' kapbhai' gu vaak gu u'vɨ ganai' xoi'kam jix buus gu u'vɨ bɨx ka't gu kutun na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' biipibop gu ñi'ook baap jix duñia' gu Raab gu taat gu naan gu ja'tkam bɨx ka't gu kutun; gio ba' gio jix duñia' bɨx gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas mai' yooxi' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tai kiicham bɨx ka't; gio ba' gu suudai' jix dhaas chumñigam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu ux gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai.

Gu' gu' gu Josuee jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Raab ganai' gu vaak gu taat bɨx ga'ra'; gio ba' jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israelitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Josuee bhañ gu oi'ñga'n gu Jerikoo.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Josuee jix duñia' bham; gio ba' gu kutun vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu chio'ñ jix duñia' gu suudai' dhi' kiicham gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr maa'nkam mar mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix ali' gu oi'ñga'n kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Josuee gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' gu ux bɨx gu oidha'.

Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jugi jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Akân gu mar gu Karmi gu mar gu Sabdi gu mar gu Sera bopxi'ñ gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr daak gu Jawatan Dios gu tai bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Josuee bhañ gu chichio'ñ dɨr gu Jerikoo gu ai ka't ju'ñdharan gu Bet-aben bhaan tas buusñi gu Bet-el; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu jodai' gu oidha'; jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu ai.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josuee gui'p; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu' jix tɨ'ɨ na ja'p gook jix bhai'x na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix bhɨɨ gu ai; na gu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam na gu' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ja'tkam na ja'p vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu ai.

Jano' ba' gu ai jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chichio'ñ bhiadat dɨr ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ux jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va gu suudai' na ja'p gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ o'lhia'n gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai daraa gu Israeel; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham.

Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu Jordaan na ba' kapbhai' gu noobh gu Amorreos gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu' gu Israeel tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Kananeos bɨx jix koi gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu suudai' chulhiiñdha' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan gu oidha'; gio ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' bamii'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vupui.

Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu' uañi'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' ka't jix aa'ñdhix; na gu' gu suudai' jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gio jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' nukadham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu ux dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu bhóogɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ jix maat gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' jix duñia' tɨbiap gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bamii' jix bhaan gu ja'tkam tu'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu xibh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu Israeel; gio ba' cham gu kutun gu chuukug vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu xibh gu ux bopxi'ñ; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ux ja'tkam vaak; mi' dhɨr ja'tkam vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ux gu vaak; jano' ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ux gu chichio'ñ.
Na gu' ka't gu takarui' gu ñi'ook ka't gu chuukug gu tai bɨx juraa'n na gu' tu' jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' jugi tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee kɨkbo gu xibh gu takarui' gu Israeel gu ux bopxi'ñ; gio ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa ka't jix bhɨɨ ja'tkam vaak gu Sera; gio ba' gu chuukug gu takarui' ja'tkam vaak gu Sera gu ux gu chichio'ñ ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Sabdi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' gu vaak gu ux gu chichio'ñ ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Akân gu mar gu Karmi gu mar gu Sabdi gu mar gu Sera bopxi'ñ gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu Akân; gio ba' gu mar gu chuukug jix maa gɇ'kamtu'nda' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duñia' bhai' ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jano' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu Akân jix aa' gu Josuee bham; gio ba' gu vaak tu' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook.

Na tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix bhai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu ja'tkam mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam bɨtaa'n gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel tuumiñ bɨtaa'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jano' ba' bhañ gu takarui' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' vaak zel; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam vaak zel tuumiñ bɨtaa'n gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel aichdhak gu Josuee bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx jix bhɨɨ gu Akân gu mar gu Sera tuumiñ gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer vaak zel bɨx gu jodai' ga'ra' bhɨɨk bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Akôr.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Israelitas jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tai mi' dhɨr gu chuukug bɨɨx gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook i'iich; mi' dhɨr gu ux dhi' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu Balle gu Akôr bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham jum i'obh tu' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ bɨndak bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bamii' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ai; jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu ja'tkam kiicham gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ai gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu vaakax jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Josuee bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu ai; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Josuee gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk bhañ gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar kiicham gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr cham jix duñia' jix jai' kiicham no'm bɨx gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu suudai' kiicham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch na ja'p jix duu va'k gu jodai' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug kiicham; na gu' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n no'ch na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu jodai' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu takarui' jix búup gu maa'nkar jix duñia' bhaan kiicham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' kapbhai' gu noobh.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tai; gio ba' jix duu jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bhañ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ja'tkam jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai tas gei'ñ gu ai; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Josuee gu bhóogɨt gu xibh jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka't jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook jix duñia' vupui bhaan kiicham jix duñia' yooxi' baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gu ai; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ai.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ja'p jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix dhaas gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai baasɨ'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam bɨx yooxi' ka't baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook kiicham gu chuukug tu' mia'n gu maa'nkar tas gei'ñ kiicham suudai' u'va gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu ai jix búup jix bhai'x gu xibh jix buus bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kiicham bhaan gu Israeel bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' jugi gu ux jix duñia' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat cham pu'ñir ka't jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n kiicham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu ux gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu ai jum daa'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bhiadat gu Josuee gu suudai' gu chuukug kiicham.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ai gu Bet-el cham gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook kiicham jix kupi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; na gu' gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu novɨ bhaan gu ai na gu' tu' kapbhai' gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix búup bhaan kiicham u'u kavɨk gu novɨ ga'ra'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo jix bhai'x pai' mi'p gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu novɨ tɨɨtɨs kiicham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ buuplhia' gu tai.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kiicham jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu suudai' kuubh kiicham jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨkɨr cham chooto'n gu chuukug na ba' gu takarui' tu' baasɨ'n tu'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug bhaan oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' bhaan oi'ñchu'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel ñɨi'ñ gu maa'nkar gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ kiicham kuubh kiicham jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu ai.
Jano' ba' moor kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel baasɨ'n; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ai aichdhak gu Josuee.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israelitas jix bɨɨx duu kooda' bɨx jix koi gu ai yooxi' oidha' jix gaki pai' gu takarui' jix daa gu suudai' bɨx jix daa gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu jodai' bɨx gu Israelitas jix duñia' gu ai gio jix dhaas gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' ia'rɨ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu chichio'ñ gu u'vɨ ka't gu kutun jix bhai'x bɨx gu ai.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee cham gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx u'u kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu jodai' bɨx jix koi gu ai.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Israelitas jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu vaakax gu takarui' kiicham jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu ñi'ook gu ai gu oi'ñga'n gɨ' kavɨk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ai jix duñia' jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' na ja'p gu tas jix dhaas jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee gu jodai' jix duu gu chuukug mi'x juu'ñ ki'ñgob kiicham; mi' dhɨr jix búup bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Josuee jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu kavɨk gu Ebal.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai jix duñia' bhaan soo'mchulhdhak jix duñia' jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' jix duñia' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gio ua'na gu jodai gu ja'tkam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees ka't ua'nak vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel daraa gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt mi'p baasɨ'n ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ux na tu ibai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't bhaan gu kavɨk gu Gerisim tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu kavɨk gu Ebal; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix va'k na ba' gu bhóogɨt ua'tulhi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga bɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jurtu'nka' bɨx ua'nak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' cham ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu Josuee cham gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel gu u'vɨ a'aalh gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu chuukug dhi' tu'x bɨx gu gɨ'kora' mi'p dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gɨ' kavɨk na ja'p gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amorreos gu Kananeos gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseos.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu takarui' na ba' gu ux bhaan gu Josuee gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' jix koi gu kutun na ja'p gu chuukug gu Josuee ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo gu ai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu kutun; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' gu chuukug jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt kɨklhi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook o'jo' kɨklhi'ñga'n suudai' u'va gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kɨklhi'ñga'n gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨt bɨɨx jajannulhi'ñ kɨklhi'ñga'n bhaan; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu bhóogɨt jix gaki jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee yooxi' gu Gilgal gui'p gu Israeel; gio ba' no'ch gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam jano' bɨɨx no'ch ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt no'ch bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee; gio ba' no'ch gu'ch tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Josuee jix aa'; jano' ba' chɨkka gu takarui' duukat jupaabkamu'n.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu duukam jix duñia' tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' oi'ñga'n gu ux gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu jodai' naak gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨx tu'x jix duu gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos mi'p baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't gu Astarot.

Jano' ba' gu ux jix bhai'x daraa bɨx jix koi gu kutun gu oidha' gui'p; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu noobh gu duukam na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'xñi; mi' dhɨr no'ch gu'ch tu duukam xoi'kam jano' bɨɨx no'ch ñi'ook na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ jix tónom gu takarui' gu vaak na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu tanoolh gu ja'tkam na ba' gu kutun gu takarui'; gio ba' gu takarui' jano' jix gaki jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam o'jo' suudai' u'va gio gu chuukug xixiibkam; gio ba' gu takarui' tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gio dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' kɨklhi'ñga'n kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu duukam gu bhóogɨt cham tɨkka gu chin gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx mi'x dhaas gu oidha'; gio ba' gio chiñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr jix duu bɨɨx gu maa'nkar gu chuukug na ja'p jix duñia' gu takarui' oi'ñka' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaik gu tanoolh jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu Beerot gu Kiriat-jearim.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' chiñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook vaak jodai bhaan chiñia'.
Gu' gu' bɨx chiñia' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' jano' cham gu takarui' kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' chulhiiñchuda' bɨɨx; na gu' mi'x dhaas duaka' na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n daak bhaan no'ch kuiñcha gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gui'p; gio ba' gu chuukug; gu' ka't gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook na ja'p chiñia' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jup tɨɨt gu Josuee bham; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu suudai' bham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu suudai' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Josuee gui'p; gio ba' na ja'p ka't jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees tu duukam ka't gu chuukug bɨx gu oidha' ka't cham tu' duu bɨx jix koi gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ux dhi' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu tasi' gu jodai' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ; gio ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' gu ñi'ook duñia' no'ch tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu; na jix duñia' gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josuee mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ux gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duu na ja'p gu Adonisedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem jix kai gu Josuee ka't jix bhɨɨ gu ai ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi gu kutun jix daa gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Israelitas mi'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' chooto'n gu bhóogɨt choo'n; na gu' gu kutun ka't kiicham na ja'p jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu ai bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu ñi'ook gu Adonisedek gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu Oam gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu Japia gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu Debir gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ tu' u'ua'tɨdham jugi gu kutun; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Josuee bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon jum daa'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx bɨx chugi'ñ jix duñia' yooxi' bhaan gu kutun gu ux bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix koi gu kutun mɨjɨ a'ga gu Josuee yooxi' gu Gilgal; gio ba' cham gu bhóogɨt gu noobh tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x no'ch na ba' nukadham u'ua'tɨdham; na gu' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos gu bhóogɨt gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Josuee gu Gilgal bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n; na gu' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee suudai' u'va jix bhai'x bɨx gu tukaa' jix tɨ'ɨ dɨr gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Israeel naaka'n bɨɨx jix koi gu kutun; gio ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu ux gu bhóogɨt jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-oron naaka'n bɨɨx ka'm gu Aseka gu Makeda.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Israelitas gu chuukug gu Bet-oron gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨkɨr gu jodai bɨɨx ka'm gu Aseka jix koko'; gio ba' mui'x gu oi'ñga'n jix koko' gu jodai gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' jix koi gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Amorreo vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oi'ñga'n gu Israelitas; gio ba' gu tas gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun; mi' dhɨr tu' gu masad gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tas gu bhóogɨt gu masad bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu ja'tkam ka't gu chuukug obhɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' cham gu jodai' ua'nak u'uan gu Jaser gu tas gu masad tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr cham jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu tanoolh gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka't jix duñia' gu tanoolh va'k tu' mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt dhaibu gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu Gilgal.
Gu' gu' jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook jumpa'n gu Makeda.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Josuee jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' jix duñia' bakia' jumpa'n gu Makeda.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Rodad gu jodai gu chin jumpa'n gu suudai' gu chichio'ñ ju'ñdharan nukadham.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n cham mi'x dhaas baakɨi jɨ'dɨlh; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' tu' dhagia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel a'lhiok gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix koi gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' yooxi' gu Josuee gu Makeda; na cham ka't gu ñi'ook nɨɨn bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Josuee; gio ba' gu chuukug gu chin jumpa'n jix buusñi dhi' ja'tkam jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' jumpa'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerimot gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon.

Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok jix buusñi dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu Josuee bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu suudai' tɨbiap bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' tɨɨt bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix dhaas tɨɨt bhaan gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee; gio ba' cham gu takarui' tu' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk; na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Josuee naaka'n jix duñia' jixchamaam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tas gu chuukug jix dhaas jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee gu jodai' jix duu mi'x juu'ñ jumpa'n pai' gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix dhaas gu jodai gu chin jumpa'n bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee gu Makeda jix dhaas gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu oidha' cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Makeda jix duu na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Makeda gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Libna; gio ba' gu ux bhaan gu Libna.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gio gu gɨ'kora' gu noobh gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gu' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Libna gu Lakîs jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan jugi.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu Lakîs gu novɨ gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Libna.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu oram gu gɨ'kora' gu Geser jix tɨ'ɨ u'ua'tɨdham gu Lakîs; gu' gu ja'tkam naaka'n gu Josuee bɨɨx ka'm cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Lakîs gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Egloon; gio ba' jix dhaas yooxi' bhaan jugi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh jix duñia' bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Egloon gu ebroon jugi.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gio ba' na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Egloon gu chuukug bɨɨx bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gɨɨsɨk gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx bhaan gu Debir jugi.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu ebroon jix duu gu Debir gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Libna gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Josuee bɨx jix suudai' duu gɨ' kavɨk saagi'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug bɨx gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook cham tu'; gio ba' bɨx ga'ra' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Josuee dɨr gu Kades-barnea bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa bɨx gu oidha' gu Goseen bɨɨx ka'm gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee jix duñia'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ux gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Josuee bɨx gu Israeel bɨɨx yooxi' gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Jabiin gu gɨ'kora' gu asor bhañ gu chuukug gu Jobab gu gɨ'kora' gu Madoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Simrom gu gɨ'kora' gu Aksap.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' mi'p baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk jix duñia' saagi'ñ gu Kinnerot gu bhóogɨt jix suudai' duu gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Kananeo ka't tas buusñi tas gei'ñ gu Amorreo gu takarui' gu jodai' gu Jebuseo gɨ' kavɨk gu ñi'ook bɨtaa'n gu ermoon gu oidha' gu Mispa.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam moor bɨɨx bɨx chugi'ñ gu ja'tkam jix jai' na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n kavaayo gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' jum daa'ñ bai'ñpu' jum daa'ñ vaak ja'tkam ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Merom na ba' gu ux bhaan gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ choo'n gu xibh dhi' gu tas tu' kapbhai' bɨx suulhgia' koko'kam vupui bhaan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr kavaayo gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Josuee bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan jix maa jix bhai'x bhaan ju'ñdharan gu suudai' gu Merom.

Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu Jawatan Dios gu noobh gu Israeel jix duñia' bhiadat bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon jix gɨ' bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu Mispa tas buusñi gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm cham mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Josuee bɨɨx na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix duñia' kavaayo gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josuee jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu asor naaka'n gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu asor ka't jix duñia' va'k mo'o bɨx dhi' ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu jodai' ka't gu ñi'ook jix duñia' cham mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Asor jix dhaas gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ja'p gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bɨx jɨ'dɨlh mi'p gu takarui' cham gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu duukam gu Asor gu ñi'ook gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ na ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu vaakax gu suudai' jɨ'dɨlh; gu' bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu cham mi'x dhaas oi'ñdha' bɨɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees tu duukam gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee; gio ba' gu Josuee jix duu cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gɨ' kavɨk bɨx jix suudai' duu saagi'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Goseen gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Israeel gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu kavɨk gu alak jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu Seir bɨɨx ka'm gu Baal-gad gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu ermoon; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu suudai' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' naaka'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ux mui'x gu tanoolh jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Josuee bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' cham ka't kiicham gu jodai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix buusñi gu ñi'ook jix koi gu kutun; gio ba' bɨx jix bhɨɨ gu ux bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Na gu' na gu' dhi' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel na ba' cham tu' duu cham jum duu gu kutun xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch va'k bhaai'n gu bhóogɨt na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gio gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Josuee jix duñia' gu Anakeos gu kakkavɨk gu ebroon gu Debir gu Anab bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu Judaa bɨx gu kakkavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Josuee jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Anakeos gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Gasa gu Gat gu Asdod.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Josuee bɨx gu oidha' jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Moisees; gio ba' do'ñcho gu Josuee gu Israelitas gu ux gu oi'ñga'n jurtu'nka' gu chuukug bopxi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix utu'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' gu oidha' gu vupui baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu jodai' gu tas dɨr gu jodai' gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ux na tu ibai'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon aapi' dɨr gu Aroer gu vaak gu jodai' gu Arnoon dɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Jabok gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' dɨr vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinnerot tas buusñi; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado tas buusñi gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu Bet-jesimot; mi' dhɨr dɨr saagi'ñ bɨtaa'n gu oi'ñga'n gu Pisga.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix daa gu Astarot gu Edrei.
Jano' ba' aapi' gu kavɨk gu ermoon gu Salka bɨx gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Gessuri gu Maakâti tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix maa mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' naaka'n gu Josuee bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas gei'ñ dɨr gu Baal-gad jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu alak jix tɨ'ɨ gu Seir; gio ba' gu oidha' jix maa gu Josuee gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu Israeel jurtu'nka' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n oidha' jix gaki saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Amorreo gu Kananeo gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerikoo maa'n; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ai gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jarmut; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Egloon; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Geser.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Debir; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Geder.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu orma; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Libna; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Makeda; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tappua; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu eper.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Apek; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Lasaroon.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Madoon; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu asor.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Simrom-meron; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Aksap.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Taanak; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Megiddo.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jokneam gu Karmel.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dor oidha' gɨ' gu Dor; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp gu Gilgal.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Tirsa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bɨx.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu Josuee tu' jix duñia' kia'mi'ñ gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' bɨx gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu Sior vupui bhaan gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Kananeos; gio ba' jixchamaam oidha' gɨ' gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr gu Gaseos gu Asdodios gu Askalonitas gu Geteos gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' saagi'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Kananeos gu Meara gu Sidonios bɨɨx ka'm gu Apek bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu suudai' bɨx gu ñi'ook bhaan pai' gu chuukug gu tas dɨr gu Baal-gad gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨɨx ka'm baakɨi gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu bhóogɨt gɨ' kavɨk dɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Sidonios; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu takarui' tu' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu Israelitas gu ux gu maa'nkar na ja'p tu' jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n tu' jano' dhi' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Na gu' na gu' ɨraab jix duñia' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Gaditas jix maa gu Moisees baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi bhaan jix maa gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Aroer jugii'ñ gu jodai' gu Arnoon kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' bɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Medeba bɨɨx ka'm gu Diboon.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix gɨ'kora' gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Gessuri gu Maakâti bɨx gu kavɨk gu ermoon bɨx gu oidha' gu Basaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Salkâ.
Jano' ba' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan jix gɨ'kora' gu Astarot gu Edrei ka't jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu Moisees naaka'n mi'x juu'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu Gessuri gu Maakâti cham mi'x juu'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' va'k gu Gessur gu Maakât jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israelitas bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix maa gu maa'nkar; gio ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Aroer jugii'ñ gu jodai' gu Arnoon kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' bɨx vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu Medeba.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Diboon gu Bamot-baal gu Bet-baal-meoon.
Jano' ba' gu Jaas gu Keddemot gu Mepaat.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sibma gu Seretsaar gu kavɨk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-peor gu chuukug gu Bet-jesimot.

Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh vaak ja'tkam bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu kutun gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix gɨ'kora' gu esboon naaka'n gu Moisees chiñia' gu Madiaan gu ebi gu Rekem gu Sur gu ur gu Reba chiñia' gu kutun oi'ñka' mii' dhɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gio mu'aa gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Balaam gu jodai' gu mar gu Beor bɨɨx gu jodai' mu'aa.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu suudai' gu Moisees bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Gad jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Jaker bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Aroer vupui bhaan gu Rabba.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Ramatmispe gu Betonim; gio ba' dɨr gu Maanaim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Debir.

Jano' ba' vaak ja'tkam gu Bet-aram gu Bet-nimra gu Sukot gu Sapoon gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu esboon; gio ba' gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinneret baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ux ja'tkam vaak dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gio jix maa gu Moisees gu oi'ñga'n ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' ka't ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't dɨr gu Maanaim bɨx gu Basaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx taañpu' gu Jair gu Basaan gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Astarot gu Edrei jɨ'dɨlh oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu Basaan gu ma'nkam gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Makîr jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Moisees jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu bhóogɨt gu Moab baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi.
Gu' gu' bopxi'ñ gu Lebii cham jix maa gu Moisees gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na ja'p ka't tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu ux gu maa'nkar gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix duñia' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix maa gu maa'nkar na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ux gu Moisees koi gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ ka't gu Moisees jix maa gu maa'nkar baasɨ'n gu Jordaan; gu' gu Lebitas cham jix maa gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Josee jix bɨɨx duu gook bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Epraim; gio ba' cham jix maa baasɨ'n gu Lebitas gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jix koi bɨɨx gu jodai' na ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Josuee gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' ñɨidhat gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Kades-barnea gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' ka't gu bhóogɨt oo'm gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhañ gu Kades-barnea gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug na ja'p ga'ra' gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu chuukug jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' jix duñia' tɨɨt cham ka't na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook duaka' na ja'p dhi' ja'tkam oo'm jixchamaam gu takarui' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel jiim gu ux oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' jano' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bhai'x jixchamaam gu takarui'.
Gu' gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Moisees bhañ; gio ba' ka't jano' ba' gu kavɨk jix duñia' jano' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' jix buus na ba' baakɨi.

Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt jano' dhi' gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; na gu' tu' gu chuukug mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Anakeos jix kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh; mi' dhɨr gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu chuukug mi'x juu'ñ na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee jano' ba' jix bhai' aa' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu ebroon gu ux gu maa'nkar.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ebroon ka't gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo gu maa'nkar bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu ebroon ka't va'k mɨmɨim gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' ka't gu Arba gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Anakeos; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' jix duñia' jɨɨpi'ñka' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ux ja'tkam vaak ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Edom oidha' jix gaki gu Sin saagi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n saagi'ñ ka't dɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado dɨr nɨɨn gu suudai' bhaan saagi'ñ.

Jano' ba' busaak bhaan saagi'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu Akrabim bhɨi bɨɨx ka'm gu Sin; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Kades-barnea gu ñi'ook gu ebroon jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu Addar jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Karka.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Asmoon busaak gu jodai' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tas buusñi gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook dɨr nɨɨn gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Bet-ogla gu ñi'ook gu Bet-araba jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai gu Boaan gu mar gu Rubeen.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Debir dɨr gu ñi'ook gu Akôr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bhaan gu Gilgal vupui bhaan jix tɨ'ɨ gu Adumin saagi'ñ gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu En-semes gu chuukug suudai' buusñi gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu suudai' gu mar gu innom gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo saagi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu suudai' gu innom bhaan tas gei'ñ gu maa'nkar gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu ux gu kavɨk bɨɨx ka'm suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu Neptoa gu chuukug jɨ'dɨlh gu kavɨk gu Eproon gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Baala gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Baala bhaan tas gei'ñ gu kavɨk gu Seir; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Jearim bhaan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu Kesaloon gu chuukug gu Bet-semes gu ñi'ook gu Timna.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Ekroon bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Sikêron gu ñi'ook gu ux gu kavɨk gu Baala gu chuukug gu Jabneel; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' jix gɨ'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu bhóogɨt gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Gu' gu' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone jix maa baasɨ'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee; gio ba' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu Anak gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu Kaleb mi'x juu'ñ vaik gu ma'nkam gu Anak gu Sesai gu Aiman gu Talmai gu ma'nkam gu Anak.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix koi gu Debir; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Debir ka't va'k gu oi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Kaleb; gio ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ tu' gu suudai' mar u'vɨ gu jodai' gu ux gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Otoniel gu mar gu Kenes xibhɨk gu Kaleb; gio ba' jix maa gu ux gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu jodai'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu suudai' gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' tu juan; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Kaleb jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix maa gu oidha' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt gio gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; jano' ba' jix maa gu ñi'ook jiix gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Edom saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu duukam gu Eder gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu Kina gu Dimona gu Adada.
Jano' ba' gu Kedes gu Asor gu Itnaan.
Jano' ba' gu Sip gu Telem gu Bealot.
Jano' ba' gu Asor-adatta gu jodai' gu Asor.
Jano' ba' gu Amam gu Sema gu Molada.
Jano' ba' gu Asar-gadda gu esmoon gu Bet-pelet.
Jano' ba' gu asar-sual gu Beerseba gu Bisotia.
Jano' ba' gu Baala gu Iim gu Esem.
Jano' ba' gu Eltolad gu Kesil gu orma.
Jano' ba' gu Siklag gu Madmanna gu Sansana.
Jano' ba' gu Lebaot gu Silim gu Aiin gu Rimmoon; gio ba' bɨx gu jodai' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu Sanoa gu Engannim gu Tappua gu Enam.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Adullam gu Sokô gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Saraim gu Aditaim gu Gedera gu Gederotaim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Senaan gu adasa gu Migdalgad.
Jano' ba' gu Dilaan gu Mispa gu Jokteel.
Jano' ba' gu Lakîs gu Boskat gu Egloon.
Jano' ba' gu Kaboon gu Lamas gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Gedero gu Bet-dagoon gu Naama gu Makeda; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Libna gu Eter gu Asaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Asna gu Nesib.
Jano' ba' gu Keila gu Aksib gu Maresa; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Ekroon bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Ekroon bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' bɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Asdod bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Asdod bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n taañpu'; gio ba' gu Gasa bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n taañpu' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Ejipto gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gɨ' kavɨk gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Danna gu jodai' gu Debir.
Jano' ba' gu Anab gu Extemoo gu Anim.
Jano' ba' gu Goseen gu Oloon gu Gilo; gio ba' gu kutun jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Arab gu Duma gu Esaan.
Jano' ba' gu Janum gu Bet-tappua gu Apeka.
Jano' ba' gu umta gu bhóogɨt gu ebroon gu Sior; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Maoon gu Karmel gu Sip gu Juta.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jokdeam gu Sanoa.
Jano' ba' gu Kaiin gu Gibea gu Timna; gio ba' mambhɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu alul gu Betpur gu Gedor.
Jano' ba' gu Maarat gu Bet-anot gu Eltekoon; gio ba' gu ux jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Rabba; gio ba' gook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Nibsan kiicham gu ñi'ook gu Engedi; gio ba' gu ux jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Gu' gu' gu Jebuseos oi'ñka' gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Judaa cham jix duñia' gu jodai'; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' gu Jebuseo gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Josee jix buus dɨr gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai' gu Jerikoo bhaan tas buusñi oidha' jix gaki jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerikoo gu kavɨk gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-el gu chuukug gu tasi' gu ñi'ook gu Arki gu Atarot.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug jix dhaav bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Japlet bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Bet-oron gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Geser; gio ba' gu chuukug gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu Manasees gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu ux ja'tkam vaak ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n gu ux na tu ibai' dɨr gu Atarot-addar bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-oron jiix.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu Mikmetat gu ñi'ook jix maa gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan tas buusñi gu Tanat-silo gu ñi'ook tas buusñi gu Janoa.
Jano' ba' gu Janoa gu chuukug gu Atarot gu Naarata gu bhóogɨt gu Jerikoo gu chuukug gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' gu Tappua gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu jodai' gu Kana gu chuukug gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gio jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Manasees bɨx jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ gu Kananeo jix daa gu Geser; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' gu Kananeo tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ka't bopxi'ñ.

Na gu' jix duñia' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu Manasees na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar gu Josee; gio ba' gu Makîr maa'nkam mar gu Manasees gu taat gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Basaan.

Jano' ba' chooto'n gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Manasees jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Abieser gu ma'nkam gu elek gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu eper gu ma'nkam gu Semida; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee gu ux ja'tkam vaak.

Gu' gu' jix duñia' gu mar gu eper gu mar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milkâ gu Tirsa.

Jano' ba' dhi' tɨɨtɨs vupui bhaan gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun chiñia' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees koi gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ xibhɨk gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu taat jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ia'rɨ gu Manasees mambhɨɨx mamai'chɨk gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Basaan baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.
Na gu' na gu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Manasees gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ma'nkam gu Manasees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Manasees dɨr gu Aser bɨɨx ka'm gu Mikmetat vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ tu jiim gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Tappua ka't gu Manasees; gu' gu Tappua ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Manasees gu ma'nkam gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Kana bhaan saagi'ñ gu jodai'; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh gu Epraim tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Manasees; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Manasees dɨr gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim saagi'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Aser baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Issakâr tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Manasees gu Issakâr gu Aser gu Bet-san taañpu' gu Ibleam taañpu' jix koi gu Dor taañpu' jix koi gu Endor taañpu' jix koi gu Taanak taañpu' jix koi gu Megiddo taañpu'; gio ba' vaik oidha' gɨ'.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees cham jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' va'k gu Kananeo gu oi'ñga'n jix daa gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ tu' na jix kavɨk jix duu bopxi'ñ gu Kananeo gu' cham mi'x juu'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee tu ñi'ook gu Josuee bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam baasɨ'n gu suudai' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu kavɨk gu oi'ñga'n na ba' tu' gu oidha' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Epraim jix duñia' na ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee gui'p; gio ba' cham jix duñia' no'ch dhi' gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Kananeos gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' vaak ja'tkam namki' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu Bet-san taañpu' gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jix aa' gu vaak gu Josee gu Epraim gu Manasees bham; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr cham gu oi'ñga'n gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk ka't gu oi'ñga'n; na gu ux tu' jix duñia' ka't gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' tu' mi'x juu'ñ gu Kananeo gu ux jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux ka't jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu Silo jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut mi' dhɨr gu oidha' ka't gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Gu' gu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel kɨɨv bopxi'ñ gu suudai' cham gu suudai' gu jodai' gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Josuee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk ka't gu takarui' na ba' jix ai gu ñi'ook gu oidha' tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat vaik gu chichio'ñ bopxi'ñ na ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' bɨx ja'k jiim gu oidha' gu o'o jurtu'nka' dɨppɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ gu vaak gu Josee no'm gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' tu' mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas matgɨm baasɨ'n namki' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui'; na gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gu Gad gio gu Rubeen ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees tu' jix duñia' dho'ñchidhak gu maa'nkar baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi jix maa gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Josuee jix duñia' na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨx ja'k jiim gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' tu' na ba' tu' mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu oidha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jɨ'dɨlh kɨɨv gu bhóogɨt u'uan jix duñia' gu Josuee yooxi' gu Silo.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee jix duñia' mamai'chɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Silo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Josuee gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ux gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' jix buus gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Josee.

Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Jordaan; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jerikoo gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ mi' dhɨr gu kavɨk bhaan tas gei'ñ jupaabkamu'n gu suudai' oidha' jix gaki gu Bet-aben.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tasi' dhi' gu Bet-el bhaan saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Atarot-addar gu kavɨk saagi'ñ gu Bet-oron gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Bet-oron saagi'ñ; gio ba' jupaabkamu'n gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ dɨr gu maa'nkar gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ gu chuukug suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu Neptoa.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu suudai' gu mar gu innom vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug gu suudai' gu innom gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseo saagi'ñ gu chuukug suudai' buusñi gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu Ensemes gu chuukug gu Gelilot vupui bhaan jix tɨ'ɨ gu Adummim tɨmñim gu jodai gu Boan gu mar gu Rubeen.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook gu Bet-ogla bhaan gu ñi'ook jupaabkamu'n gu suudai' gu ñi'ook nɨɨn gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jordaan saagi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jordaan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook tas buusñi; gio ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xikoolh jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu ux ja'tkam vaak jix bɨɨx duu gu maa'nkar gu Bet-ogla gu suudai' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-araba gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Bet-el.
Jano' ba' gu Abim na ba' gu Opra.
Jano' ba' gu Kepar-ammonai gu Opni jix duñia'; gio ba' gu kutun jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu kutun gu Rama gu Beerot.
Jano' ba' gu Mispa gu Kepira gu Mosa.
Jano' ba' gu Rekom gu Irpeel gu Tarala.
Jano' ba' gu Sela gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jebus gu Jerusalem gu Gibeat gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gookim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu Simeoon gu ux bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu maa'nkar ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' chooto'n gu maa'nkar gu Beer-seba gu Seba gu Molada.
Jano' ba' gu asar-sual gu Bala gu Esem.
Jano' ba' gu eltolad gu Betul gu orma.
Jano' ba' gu Siklag gu Bet-markâbot gu asar-susa.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-lebaot gu Sarueen; gio ba' gu suudai' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu Aiin gu Rimmoon gu Eter gu Asaan; gio ba' maakobh jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx taañpu' mi'p xikoolh dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx ka'm gu Baalat-beer gu Ramat saagi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon bhaan ja'tkam vaak.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa ka't jix buusñi gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon; na gu' baasɨ'n gu ma'nkam gu Judaa ka't gu ñi'ook na ba'; na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon chooto'n gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar ka't bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu Dabbe-set gu takarui' gu jodai' vupui bhaan gu Jokneam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Sarid bhaan tas buusñi pai' gu bhóogɨt gu tas gu ñi'ook gu Kisilot-tabor gu chuukug gu Dabrat jix tɨ'ɨ gu Japia.
Jano' ba' bhɨi bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ux na tu ibai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu Rimmoon gu jodai' gu Nea.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu anatoon bai'ñpu' gu suudai' gu Iptael.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Kata gu Naalal gu Simroon gu Ideala gu Bet-leem; gio ba' gu kutun jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu Issakâr gu ux gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Kesullot gu Sunem.
Jano' ba' gu aparaim gu Sioon gu Anaarat.
Jano' ba' gu Rabbit gu Kisioon gu Ebes.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu En-gannim gu En-adda gu Bet-passes.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' dhi' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Tabor gu Saasim gu Bet-semes; gio ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr mambhɨɨx gu ux jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu elkât gu alii gu Beteen gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Alammelek gu Amead gu Miseal; gio ba' gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu Karmel tas gei'ñ gu Sior-libnat.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' pai' gu bhóogɨt gu tas gu Bet-dagoon gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Iptael gu ñi'ook gu Bet-emek gu Neiel gu chuukug gu Kabul o'nsop.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ebroon gu Reob gu ammoon gu Kana bɨɨx ka'm gu Sidoon.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm jix kavɨk kiicham gu Tiro gu chuukug dhi' gu ñi'ook gu osa gu chuukug gu gɨ' suudai' dɨr gu suudai' gu Aksib.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gio gu Umma gu Apek gu Reob; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ux gu ma'nkam gu chuukug jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu elep gu jodai' gu Adami-nekeb gu Jabneel bɨɨx ka'm gu Lakum; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhi' gu ñi'ook bhaan tas gei'ñ gu Asnot-tabor gu takarui' gu ukuka gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ tas gei'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx gu Aser bɨɨx gu Judaa gu Jordaan bhaan pai' gu bhóogɨt gu tas.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Siddim gu Ser gu amat gu Rakkat gu Kinnerot.
Jano' ba' gu Adama gu Rama gu Asor.
Jano' ba' gu Kedes gu Edrei gu En-asor.
Jano' ba' gu Iroon gu Migdalel gu orem gu Bet-anat gu Bet-semes; gio ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ux ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu ux ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Sora gu Estaol gu Ir-semes.
Jano' ba' gu Saalabiin gu Ailoon gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Eloon gu Timnata gu Ekroon.
Jano' ba' gu Eltekê gu Gibbetoon gu Baalat.
Jano' ba' gu Jeud gu Bene-beraak gu Gat-rimmoon.
Jano' ba' gu Mejarkoon gu Rakkoon bɨɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Joppa.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Dan; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ma'nkam gu Dan jugi gu Lesem jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu kuchii gu vupui jix daa; mi' dhɨr tɨɨt gu Lesem gu Dan gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dan gu taat.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan jurtu'nka' ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa kiicham jix duñia' gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' jix duñia' kiicham jix daa.

Jano' ba' dhi' dɨppɨr gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat kapbhai' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Silo vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ba'k vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Josuee bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' nɨi'ñchudat jɨ'dɨlh gu kutun tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux gu Moisees.
Na ba' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mua'kam gu bhóogɨt oi'ñdha' gu ux gu vaak cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na ka't gu ux gu jodai' mia'n jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' ki'ñgob kiicham gu chuukug gu takarui' daraa mii' dhɨr kiicham; gio ba' gu takarui' baidhak gu ñi'ook kiicham jix duñia' pai' jix duñia' bɨɨx.
