Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk mia'n jix koi gu chuukug cham kapbhai' gu novɨ mua'kam na gu' naaka'n tɨtmo gu ñi'ook gu vaak tu' jix duñia' bɨɨx va'k gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' mii' dhɨr kiicham bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm koi'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' mua'kam jix duñia' ɨlhdham kiicham gu vaak kiicham pai' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu Kedes gu Galilea gu kavɨk gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu bhóogɨt gu ebroon gu kavɨk gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi nɨi'ñchudat gu Beser oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Ramot gu Galaad bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Gauloon gu Basaan bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix bɨɨx duu jɨ'dɨlh nɨi'ñchudat na ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu ux gu vaak cham vaak jodai gu ux gu novɨ mia'n jix koi bɨɨx ka'm jugi vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tattat gu Lebitas tɨɨtɨs gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu ñi'ook tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Silo gu oidha' gu Kanaan bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu ux gu Moisees bhaai'n gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n na ba' jix daa bɨɨx gu jodai' na ba' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux ja'tkam vaak gu Koatitas; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu Lebitas gu ux bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu ux gu Simeoon gu ux gu Benjamiin gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix maa gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mambhɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Epraim bopxi'ñ gu Dan ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu ux ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr bopxi'ñ gu Aser bopxi'ñ gu chuukug ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Basaan jix bɨɨx duu gɨ' vaak ja'tkam gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ux ja'tkam vaak jix maa gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu ux bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu ux bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu ux bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Lebitas dhi' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu jodai' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu ux gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon jix maa dhi' gu oi'ñga'n jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon ja'tkam vaak gu Koat gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu taat gu Anak gu ebroon gu kavɨk gu Judaa bɨɨx gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' yooxi' gu chuukug kiicham taañpu' jix maa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu ux gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa kiicham gu kutun na ba' gu takarui' gu ebroon bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' gu Libna bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jattir bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Extemoo bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Debir bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Ain bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Jutta bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Bet-semes bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gook bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Gibeoon bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Geba bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Anatot bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Almoon bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu suudai' bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Gu' gu' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bopxi'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun na ba' gu takarui' bɨɨx gu jodai' gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu Geser bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Kibsaim bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Bet-oron bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu Elteko bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Gibetoon bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Ayaloon bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Taanak bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Gat-rimmoon bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' gook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix bɨɨx duu mambhɨɨx bɨɨx gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Lebitas jix maa gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun na ba' gu takarui' ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' gu takarui' gu Basaan bɨɨx gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Daberet bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jarmut bɨɨx gu jodai' gu En-gannim bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu Miseal bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Abdoon bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu elkât bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Reob bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun na ba' gu takarui' gu Kedes gu Galilea bɨɨx gu jodai' gu ammot-dor bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Kartaan bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' vaik gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Gersonitas gu ux ja'tkam vaak jix bɨɨx duu gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook jix maa bopxi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨɨx gu jodai' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Dimna bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Naalal bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Beser bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Jasa bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Kedemot bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Mepaat bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun na ba' gu takarui' gu Ramot gu Galaad bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Maanaim bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu esboon bɨɨx gu jodai' gu Jaker bɨɨx gu jodai'; gio ba' maakobh gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu ux ja'tkam vaak jix duñia' ja'tkam vaak gu Lebitas jix bɨɨx duu gu ux mamai'chɨk gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu oo'm gu tasi' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh mi'p gu takarui' bɨɨx gu jodai' xikoolh; gio ba' ka't bɨx dhi' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨx gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug tattat; gio ba' gu vupui jix daa.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' xikoolh jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook tattat; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josuee jup tɨɨt gu jodai' gu Gaditas ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' nukadham bɨx gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx jix aa'ñdhix.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Timnat-sera gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Josuee bɨx gu ñi'ook daraa jix duñia' mi' dhɨr gu Josuee gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx buimɨi gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt o'oo gu Josee gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu suudai' gu jodai' gu Ejipto baasɨ'n yooxi' gu Jakob jugi gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook ali' karneer; gio ba' ka't gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Josee.
Jano' ba' gio jix koi gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Pinees gu mar ka't jix maa gu kavɨk gu Epraim.
